name: Villafranca del Campo (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a band of yellow and red bars from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with a blue lozenge bearing a yellow castle and wheat.
history: Municipal flag of Villafranca del Campo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band of yellow and red bars from the upper hoist to the lower fly
castle above wheat on the lozenge
